mapper.select:
select u.user_id userId,u.user_name userName,u.nick_name nickName,u.phonenumber,u.status, u.agent_level agentLevel,u.parent_user_id parentUserId,p.user_name parentUserName, coalesce(sum(q.remain_count),0) totalRemainCount,u.create_time createTime from sys_user u left join sys_user p on p.user_id=u.parent_user_id left join mark_user_platform_quota q on q.user_id=u.user_id where u.del_flag=0
and u.agent_level is null and p.agent_level=2 and u.agent_level=2 and u.agent_level=1
and u.parent_user_id=#{parentUserId} and (u.user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.nick_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.phonenumber like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and u.status=#{status} group by u.user_id,u.user_name,u.nick_name,u.phonenumber,u.status,u.agent_level,u.parent_user_id,p.user_name,u.create_time order by u.user_id desc

select id,transaction_no transactionNo,request_no requestNo,transaction_type transactionType, platform_code platformCode,platform_name platformName,amount,from_user_id fromUserId,to_user_id toUserId, operator_user_id operatorUserId,reason,status,create_time createTime from mark_agent_point_transaction where request_no=#{requestNo} limit 1
select role_id from sys_role where role_key=#{roleKey} and status='0' and del_flag='0' limit 1
